The [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] '''royal air cruiser''' was a model of [[air cruiser]] employed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

==Characteristics==
The airspeeder frame was devoted to propulsion, while the power supply for the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannon was installed just above the cannon itself. Royal air cruisers provided firepower that could level enemy ground installations or take out slow-moving artillery, but were not well suited to defending against ground troops, airspeeders, or ground speeders.

==History==
[[File:RoyalAirCruiser.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Multiple views of air cruiser.]]

The design presented an engineering challenge to the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] because the goal was to mount a turbolaser cannon with firepower typical for a capital starship onto a mid-sized tactical airspeeder. They compromised by essentially hanging the cannon below a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]]-like vessel shaped like a flying wing.

==Behind the scenes==
The Royal air cruiser pilot was voiced by [[Paula Killen]] in the game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.<ref name="gbcc">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'' credits screen, <code>Game\Data\LIST_x1.CRX</code></ref>
